editorial:
Ever wondered what it would be like to see a fighting game come to life with zero limits on the gore? You get exactly that here. You follow Hanzo Hasashi, a family man who loses everything to the cold-hearted Sub-Zero. He ends up in a hellish place called the Netherrealm, where he makes a deal with a creepy sorcerer to get his revenge. He comes back as Scorpion, a fiery ghost who only cares about killing his enemy. Meanwhile, you get to see a mismatched group of heroes like the cocky Johnny Cage and the tough Sonya Blade team up with Liu Kang to stop a massive invasion from another world. It feels like a high-energy comic book with a lot of blood and heart.

The fight scenes are the best part because they are fast, brutal, and look amazing. The voice acting is solid, and the movie doesn't waste your time with boring parts. If you aren't into extreme violence, you might find some parts too much, but for most fans, it is a total blast.
endingExplained: In the big finale, Scorpion finally faces Sub-Zero and wins, but he discovers that Quan Chi tricked him the whole time. He realizes that revenge didn't bring his family back. Meanwhile, Liu Kang beats Shang Tsung in a massive battle to save Earth. Scorpion decides to stop being a pawn and teams up with the heroes. He finds peace by letting go of his hate, and the movie ends with the warriors ready for the next fight.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fighting games and adult animation.
